# Vendored dependencies

| Library | Version | License | Source |
|---------|---------|---------|--------|
| [Catch2](https://github.com/catchorg/Catch2) | 2.13.10 | BSL-1.0 | catch2.hpp |
| [CLI11](https://github.com/CLIUtils/CLI11) | 2.x | BSD-3-Clause | CLI11.hpp |
| [nlohmann/json](https://github.com/nlohmann/json) | 3.x | MIT | json.hpp |
| [cpp-httplib](https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib) | latest | MIT | httplib.h |

All four are header-only and vendored as single-file releases. No build step required.
